steps.say: A sample must be registered before a trial can be filed under it. Press New sample (if a sample is already chosen, press Clear sample first).
Type the sample ID and pick its material. The sample is required; its photo is optional (only a flake needs one). Press Add photo to attach one, or press Next.
Press Add sample to save it.
A chip belongs to the sample chosen above; the Chip list opens once a sample is chosen. Press New chip.
Type the chip ID and press Add chip. Every flake belongs to a chip, so the chip is required; only its photo is optional.
A flake belongs to the chip chosen above; the Flake list opens once a chip is chosen. Press New flake.
Type the flake ID and add at least one photo with Add photo (a flake needs one), then press Add flake. The sample, chip and flake now appear in the pickers.
